items.title: Canada makes pitch as safe place to invest in 'uncertain world'
items.summary: Canada is a safe place to invest "in a very uncertain world," Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne told AFP Monday, ahead of a summit where the country is seeking an unprecedented influx of private-sector investment.In recent years, Canada has faced criticism from private-sector leaders who say the country is a difficult place to invest, citing lengthy and bureaucratic project approval processes.
